personal.name: Utku Ege Tuluk
personal.title: Research Engineer & AI and Emerging Technology Manager
personal.bio: Research Engineer and AI & Emerging Technology Manager at NYU Shanghai with 3+ years building production AI for education. Leads the Ask, Create, Train framework: multi-tenant AI assistants, an internal platform for AI-powered apps, and on-premises serving of quantized open-weight LLMs. Built Kiwi, a multimodal learning platform serving 300+ students and processing 100M+ tokens. Expertise in full-stack development, LLM infrastructure, and AI agents.

projects.title: KIWI - Multimodal AI Learning Platform
projects.description: Enterprise-scale multimodal learning platform serving 300+ students across 6 classes, featuring real-time AI-powered chat, intelligent PDF annotation, and in-browser Python execution.
projects.longDescription: Built a production-grade educational platform with real-time streaming chat supporting multiple LLMs, AI-powered PDF annotation and highlighting, vector-based document search, and multi-class deployment automation. Processed 100M+ tokens with 5x deployment speed improvement and 99.9% uptime. Extended with Kiwi Apps (sandboxed third-party apps connected through a postMessage SDK, including an AI coding-exercise service that grades code in isolated Docker containers) and a built-in MCP server. Research published as KiwiNotebook at the ACM CHI 2024 Workshop on Human-Notebook Interactions.

projects.title: ASK - Multi-Tenant AI Assistant Platform
projects.description: Multi-tenant AI assistant platform behind NYU Shanghai's Ask Angie (faculty support), Ask Roary (library), and Ask RITS, cutting faculty response times from hours to instant.
projects.longDescription: Customizable multi-tenant assistant framework with role-based access control, English/Chinese support, a document pipeline with hybrid vector/text search, and in-browser Whisper speech input. Assistants run an agent loop with tool calling over self-hosted models; MCP tool servers for campus services are provisioned as sandboxed Docker containers behind per-server egress allowlists, and prompt changes are validated with promptfoo evaluations.

projects.title: Create - AI Sites Platform
projects.description: Internal multi-tenant platform where NYU Shanghai users deploy small web apps, or generate them from a prompt, each with its own database, storage, serverless functions, and campus-hosted LLM access.
projects.longDescription: Built RITS's internal Sites platform: upload a project or generate one from a prompt in Studio, and it gets a private subdomain, a per-tenant PostgreSQL database, an object-storage bucket, Deno functions, and managed LLM access. Includes immutable deploys, guest-list access control, 30-day analytics, an operator admin console, a CLI, and an MCP endpoint so coding agents can deploy directly. Hosts internal tools such as an AI song generator, a vocabulary-constrained Chinese tutor, and a spreadsheet decision assistant.

projects.title: On-Premises LLM Inference Stack
projects.description: Production LLM serving for NYU Shanghai: quantized open-weight models on on-premises and HPC GPUs, exposed through a LiteLLM gateway to campus apps and users.
projects.longDescription: Serves models such as Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (FP8, tensor parallel across 4x RTX 4090, 256k context) and Qwen3.8-27B (AWQ INT4, TP=2 x DP=4 across 8x RTX 3090) with vLLM, scheduled through Slurm on the university HPC cluster. A LiteLLM gateway with custom hooks issues per-user API keys over separate on-campus and Cloudflare Tunnel paths. The RITS GPU fleet (9 GPUs, ~243 GiB VRAM) also hosts image, video, and music generation models.

projects.title: AI Companion - App, Voice & Hardware
projects.description: Full-stack AI companion product: a mobile app with personality-driven characters, voice-cloned speech, and a Bluetooth companion device with on-device wake-word recognition.
projects.longDescription: Built the React Native app (character chat, personality system, 3D scenes, BLE device control) and started a native SwiftUI port; a NestJS/PostgreSQL backend and admin console on Terraform-provisioned AWS; a voice-cloning TTS service on serverless GPUs, benchmarked from A100 to B200; ESP32-S3 firmware with ESP-SR wake-word and command recognition; and a real-time fur renderer with 14 custom GLSL shaders for the characters.

projects.title: AI Song Generation Service
projects.description: Self-hosted text-to-song service at NYU Shanghai: lyrics and a style prompt become a full song with vocals, generated on a single 12 GB GPU.
projects.longDescription: Runs YuE2-3B through a pinned, locally patched audio.cpp engine at roughly real-time speed on an RTX 3060, with an LLM agent that turns rough ideas into model-ready lyrics and style tags, audio-referenced generation through a patched MERT encoder, a web UI, and an Icecast/Liquidsoap radio stream of generated songs.

projects.title: Fly Brain Robot
projects.description: A complete fruit-fly connectome, simulated as 165k spiking neurons, sees through a robot arm's cameras and drives its joints through the fly's own front-leg motor neurons.
projects.longDescription: Connects the MaleCNS v1.0 connectome, simulated as 165k leaky integrate-and-fire neurons, to a MuJoCo model of a PiPER X arm with an Aero Hand. Camera frames pass through the flyvis visual-system model, and front-leg motor-neuron spikes map to joint commands; a visual stimulus drove 147 front-leg motor spikes against 20 for a blank screen.

projects.title: MiniMax-H3 on Apple Silicon
projects.description: Runs MiniMax-H3 text-to-video-with-audio locally on a MacBook by rebuilding its MLX 4-bit pack byte-for-byte from the official BF16 weights.
projects.longDescription: HuggingFace downloads were too slow to be usable from Shanghai, so this pulls MiniMax's official BF16 checkpoint from ModelScope at 59 MB/s and rebuilds the published MLX 4-bit pack locally, verified byte-for-byte against it. On an M5 Pro with 48 GB it generates 5.17 s of 832x480 video with synchronised stereo audio in 247 s. Along the way it documents an undocumented qkv weight relayout, stores the second checkpoint as a 3.85x-compressed delta (18.70 GB to 4.86 GB), and adds an audio-only mode that is ~25x faster.

projects.title: Spiegel - AI VTuber Platform
projects.description: AI VTuber streaming platform: a desktop chat aggregator for YouTube, Twitch, and Kick plus an AI-driven avatar with real-time lip-sync and speech.
projects.longDescription: The Chat Helper unifies live chat from YouTube, Twitch, and Kick into one prioritized feed with flood detection, SuperChat highlighting, and an OBS overlay, and has been used for 100+ hours of streaming. The AI Avatar drives a Live2D/VRM character from an LLM with streaming text-to-speech, voice-activity detection, lip-sync, and emotion-driven expressions, rendered on a transparent background for OBS.
